text:
Alex Chen: quick async standup: what I did / blockers / today

Alex Chen: DID: landed kernel patch to reduce slot contention (kernel/shard fairness), added opt to prefer short-seqs for prefetch. Ran microbench for batcher latency.

Alex Chen: BLOCKERS: still seeing ~8% p99 regressions on kv-warmup under microburst; suspect race in kv-evict path when prefetched slots collide. Logs attached.

Alex Chen: TODAY: bisect kernel change + reproduce locally; push hotfix if confirmed; ping reviewers for the microbatch PR.

Maya Patel: saw the p99 spike too on canary. I dug a bit — eviction queue depth spikes when prefetch window overlaps with an active write. will add a telemetry flag to track overlap counts. @Alex Chen can you share the failing log snippet?

Alex Chen: here's a trimmed log snippet and repro cmd:
```
E 14:12:34 kernel: kv_evict: slot=42 owner=slot-manager assert failed: cache_idx != -1
W 14:12:34 batcher: microburst detected size=12
CMD: ./run_local.sh --workload=kv-warmup --seq=short --iters=200
```

Joel Rivera: I'll take a look at the eviction logic today. If it's the owner check we can try a cheap CAS around cache_idx before evict. Also will review PR #512 (kernel: batcher fairness) — pinged you on the PR for a quick gate.

Evelyn (ci-bot): CI status for branch alex/kernel-fairness: build passed ✅, unit tests passed, integration tests failed (kv-warmup-canary) — failing test: evict_concurrency_test

Sam Ortiz: on-call today, I can run a few perf sweeps. give me the workload id and exact bench cmd, I'll run with both old and new kernel to compare.

Alex Chen: thanks — workload id wk-931. Use:
```
./bench --id=wk-931 --profile=kv-warmup --clients=32 --requests=10000
```
Aim for 3 runs each, collect p50/p95/p99 + evict-overlap metric (Maya will add flag). :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: adding telemetry flag now: `--telemetry=evict_overlap` will be in a patch shortly.

Joel Rivera: noted, will try CAS but same-day hotpatch if tests go green.

Alex Chen: small ask — reviewers, if you can prioritize #512 and the hotpatch review today that'd help ship a rollback quickly if needed. TY!

Sam Ortiz: will post perf results in ~45m.

Evelyn (ci-bot): Reminder: deployment window 18:00-19:00 UTC — request reviews before 17:30 to make cutoff.

Maya Patel: got it. ping me if you need help triaging the canary failures.

Alex Chen: thanks team. will update thread when I have repro. :wave:
